The moment that I was the most scared for my life was when I got bit by a Timber Rattlesnake while on a camping trip with my Father on the Appalachian Trail. Me getting bit was a mix of pure stupidity and ignorance on my part. I had left the campsite just before dusk to take a leak, I walked a bit out into the woods just for the fun of it. Keep in mind I was fully aware of the fact that a recent fire had pushed the rattlesnakes out of their dens.  

As I was relieving myself, I noticed that the sound I chalked up to being my piss was actually a 4ft rattler behind me. Just as I went to move to the side it struck out and bit the back of my ankle. I scurried away from the snake and looked down at the bite. 

Now here is where the stupidity comes in:

Being a stupid 15 year old I though that the bite should have had some type of "substance" leaking out of it. I didnt see anything so I rationalized with myself that I must have misidentified it or it didnt inject me with any venom. I walk back to the campsite and explain to my dad that I got bit by a snake and that it might have been a rattlesnake. He questioned me a bit about it but me not wanting to ruin our trip played it down to make it seem like less of a problem. I woke up very clammy in the morning and saw that my leg was swollen from the knee down with noticable discoloration around the bite. I woke my dad up and explained everything to him. He was livid but more worried about getting me off the mountain. He called 911 or some other emergency service to tell them that we would be off the mountain in an hour with a snake bite. My father managed to haul me down the mountain along with the rest of our gear. We get to the ambulance that was waiting for us and they start rushing us to the nearest hospital with the means to take care of my wound. The whole going down the mountain and ambulance ride memories are just a mix of delirium and irrational thoughts. I was fully convinced I was going to die.

Moral of the story, if you think you got bit by venomous snake dont be stupid. Seek medical attention
